What We Do

Our Roofing Services

From a single slipped tile to a full re-roof, we cover pitched and flat roofs for homes and businesses across Derbyshire.

New Roofs and Re-Roofs

Full tiled and slate roofs, stripped back to the rafters and rebuilt with new membrane, battens and tiles.

Get a quote

Roof Repairs

Leaks, slipped tiles, storm and wind damage, ridges and verges, found quickly and put right properly.

Get a quote

Flat Roofing

EPDM rubber and Lava 20 torch-on systems for extensions, dormers, garages and outbuildings.

Get a quote

Chimneys and Leadwork

Chimney repairs and repointing, plus leadwork around flashings, valleys and abutments.

Get a quote

Fascias, Soffits and Guttering

New roofline and gutters that carry water away cleanly and protect the walls below.

Get a quote

Dormers and Roof Windows

Dormer roofs and cladding, plus skylights and roof windows that bring light into the loft.

See The Difference

Before and After

See three recent projects go from tired to transformed. Real roofs, real results, all completed here in Derbyshire.

Before → After
Full Re-Roof

Stripped back and built to last

Taken right back to the rafters and rebuilt properly: new felt, treated battens and interlocking tiles, with fresh ridge, verge and leadwork throughout. The finish is clean and uniform, sealing the whole home against the worst of the Derbyshire weather.

Matlock
Before → After
Conservatory Warm Roof

From cold add-on to year-round room

This old polycarbonate conservatory roof was freezing in winter and baking in summer. We replaced it with a fully insulated, tiled warm roof that is quiet, energy-efficient and finished with a smooth plastered ceiling inside. A wasted space became a bright room the family now uses all year round.

Ripley
Before After
Loft Conversion Re-Roof

A new roofline for a bigger home

As part of a full loft conversion we re-roofed the entire property, with new structure, membrane and tiles bringing the whole roofline up to a modern, weatherproof standard, ready for the extra living space created below.

About Us

The Team Behind Holt Roofing

Holt Roofing Ltd is a Derbyshire-based roofing company built on a simple idea: do the job properly, treat people fairly, and stand behind the work. From small repairs to full re-roofs and loft conversions, every job gets the same care and attention to detail.

We pride ourselves on being experienced and trusted. We turn up when we say we will, keep you informed and leave your property clean and tidy. With free advice, free quotes and a 24-hour emergency call-out, help is never far away.
